description: Implementation of MemoryItemViewModel class methods for memory operations in a calculator application.

classes.name: MemoryItemViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel class handling memory item operations such as clear, add, and subtract in the calculator app.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the memory item at the current position.

methods.name: MemoryAdd
methods.description: Adds the current memory item to the calculator's memory.

methods.name: MemorySubtract
methods.description: Subtracts the current memory item from the calculator's memory.
